title: HB390 (2021 Regular): AN ACT relating to pretrial diversion.

other_topics: judicial-criminal-justice: Section 1 (KRS 533.250) — pretrial diversion plea acceptance suspended until a violation or completion

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/21RS/hb390/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 2276224))

operative_text: Section 2 (new section of KRS 533.250 to 533.262): Any person who has accepted a pretrial diversion agreement shall retain his or her right to possess and have access to a firearm unless the court makes: (1) A finding of fact that the crime for which the person was charged involved the use of a firearm; and (2) A specific finding of fact that it is in the interest of the defendant and public to restrict access to firearms.
